title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust sets a clear protocol for trustworthiness, ensuring consistent, reliable navigation across all AI systems.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking provides measurable standards, allowing progress to be tracked and flaws to be exposed through real-world testing.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates with existing protocols like ROS2, enabling seamless adoption without requiring full system overhauls.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking reveals hidden biases in navigation algorithms, something a protocol alone can’t address without empirical data.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Without benchmarking, we’re just trusting protocols blindly—no way to know if they’re actually working.
